children: Spanish retail sales fell 0.3% in July from a year earlier on a calendar-adjusted basis and excluding the effects of inflation, from a revised increase of 0.6% in June, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Friday.
The June figure was revised up from a preliminary increase of 0.5%, INE said.
